title: I2V-DETACH: Source Grounding Detachment for Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation
title_zh: 【输入内容第一行】I2V-DETACH：面向未授权图生视频的源关联剥离防御方法

paragraphs.en: I2V-DETACH提出一种图像免疫方法，通过切断源图像线索传播并增强视频内部交互，有效阻止未经授权的图生视频内容生成。 Recent diffusion models have advanced image-conditioned video generation, but their accessibility raises risks of unauthorized manipulation. Image immunization has emerged as a promising defense for Image-to-Video (I2V) protection, yet existing methods often rely on degrading visual quality or temporal coherence. In this work, we revisit I2V immunization as reducing source-content preservation, shifting the focus from output degradation to weakening source-conditioned content propagation. To this end, we propose I2V-DETACH, an image immunization method that prevents unauthorized I2V generation through source grounding detachment. I2V models preserve source content by propagating source-image cues into video latents during denoising. Accordingly, I2V-DETACH disrupts this process in two complementary ways: it suppresses source-video grounding to reduce source cue propagation, and strengthens intra-video interactions to shift denoising toward video-side dynamics with reduced reliance on the source image. To obtain informative optimization signals, we initialize auxiliary video latents with source-oriented states that remain within the source-conditioned generation regime while deviating from source-preserving trajectories. Extensive experiments across diverse diffusion architectures show that I2V-DETACH substantially reduces source-content preservation, improves over prior immunization methods, and exhibits strong black-box transferability.
paragraphs.zh: I2V-DETACH 提出了一种图像免疫方法，通过切断源图像线索传播并增强视频内部交互，有效阻止未经授权的图生视频内容生成。近期的扩散模型推动了图像条件视频生成的发展，但其易用性也带来了未经授权操控的风险。 图像免疫已成为图生视频（I2V）保护的一种有前景的防御手段，但现有方法往往依赖于降低视觉质量或时间一致性。 在本工作中，我们将 I2V 免疫重新定义为减少源内容保留，把关注点从输出退化转向削弱源条件内容传播。 为此，我们提出 I2V-DETACH，一种通过源锚定分离来阻止未经授权 I2V 生成的图像免疫方法。 I2V 模型通过在去噪过程中将源图像线索传播到视频隐变量中来保留源内容。 因此，I2V-DETACH 以两种互补方式破坏这一过程：抑制源-视频锚定以减少源线索传播，并增强视频内部交互，使去噪转向视频侧的动态，从而降低对源图像的依赖。 为了获得有信息量的优化信号，我们用面向源的状态初始化辅助视频隐变量，这些状态保持在源条件生成区域内，同时偏离源保留轨迹。 在多种扩散架构上的大量实验表明，I2V-DETACH 大幅减少了源内容保留，优于已有的免疫方法，并展现出强大的黑盒可迁移性。
